Dear Principle, If our school were to change the cafeteria food to healthier food selections it would be a bad idea. This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.
